title: Hiking Gaiters – Keep Snow, Water & Grit Out
descriptionHtml:
Wet socks decide the trip before tired legs do

Snow from below, wet undergrowth, grit that finds its way down into the boot – it's rarely the weather that ends the trip, but what gets in from below.

Gaiters that seal the gap between boot and knee

Hook onto the laces, pull the strap under the foot and fasten the hook-and-loop closure around your leg – 44 centimeters of protection in 100 % polyester keeps snow, water and grit out all the way up. One size that adjusts to your leg.

Features

  • Socks stay dry – 44 cm high protection against snow, water and wet undergrowth
  • No grit in your boots – seals tightly around boot and leg
  • Stays put with every step – hook on the laces, strap under the foot, hook-and-loop closure around the leg
  • Easy to spot in the terrain – yellow, neon green or orange
  • One size, adjustable – 44 cm high, 43 cm circumference, fits most adults

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
